notes.title: Team Update - Recent Ban Waves
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/1lRc0vqyB3SIciI5BmRM8w/4a8d2f148595e609683b54ff1d71b3a7/destroyer_characterart_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
[h2]Heroes of Arkesia,[/h2]

We wanted to take a moment to discuss recent ban waves, publicly share some updated plans related to one of the core tenets of the Amazon Games Code of Conduct— Play Fair. Specifically, we want to discuss the ban waves, and provide a few policy reminders related to RMT and botting behavior.

[b]Anti-Cheat and Anti-bot Measures[/b]
Do not cheat, bot, hack, or use other software or services that give you an unfair advantage through, for example, unattended gameplay or game modifications.

Combatting bots has been an ongoing initiative of collaboration between our internal Anti-Cheat teams, Easy Anti-Cheat, and Smilegate RPG. We are constantly evolving detection methods and limiting the impact that bots can have on the economy and general player experience, along with the the use of illicit programs that allow players to automate daily activities and tasks within the game.

After reviewing the ban waves, our team found that some accounts, which had no prior violations or bad behavior, used the program to automate daily tasks. While these accounts did not deserve a permanent ban, using the program still violates the Code of Conduct, and it warrants a serious infraction. As a result, these accounts will have their permanent bans reduced to a 30-day suspension. The days already spent banned will count toward this 30-day suspension.

We hope that these players will embody the tenet of “Play Fair” heading forward, especially with the recent changes to reduce the load of dailies by speeding up activities and only requiring a single Kurzan Frontline/Chaos Dungeon per character each day. Any further infractions or violations will result in the permanent ban being reinstated.

[b]RMT Bans[/b]
Do not engage in real-money trading of in-game items and in-game currencies.

RMT Bans have and will, continue to rollout in an ongoing basis. We have seen a lot of community conversations discussing the bans, along with false narratives being publicly shared, so we wanted to provide a few reminders and clarifications. First off, RMT investigations are thoroughly vetted and manually looked into. Oftentimes, players are not willing to share the entire truth after engaging in behavior violating the Code of Conduct, which can lead to speculation and confusion in the community. Additionally, ban/suspension appeals are manually reviewed, not automatically declined. While there are response templates built to communicate a decision, they are not automatically sent out. These responses can be sent out quickly to communicate decisions after an appeal is reviewed, especially in cases where the evidence of illicit activities is concrete, or when the appeal provided was not relevant to the reason for the ban.

If you ever in doubt of whether or not an action is allowed, please review the Amazon Games Code of Conduct or Terms of Service. Thank you for your continued support, and we’ll see you in Arkesia.

notes.title: Call of the Wildsoul — The February Update
notes.content:

The Ark Passive system is undergoing a massive transformation, streamlining gear progression, skill synergy, and accessibility across all tiers. Experience the Next Era of Arkesia[/b]

notes.title: Class Spotlight: Wildsoul — Unleash the Wildsoul Within
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/4uDVFm941E8oWD4ThlXM9j/bd3aee119571455aba91afed349f8ed0/LA_Wildsoul_Transform_Final_1920x1080_CT-000000000.jpg[/img]
The call of the wild is relentless, a force that cannot be ignored. Those who answer it become more than warriors; they become legends. Introducing the Wildsoul class, arriving in Arkesia on February 26th, a striking new addition that embodies the raw, unbridled energy of nature’s fiercest protectors. Whether you harness the spirit of the celestial or revel in the shadows of the unknown, this class is a testament to the balance of grace, power, and primal might.

Players eager to unlock Wildsoul’s full potential can embark on a Class Awakening Quest, earning 15 new achievements, a new title, and a new trophy, along with a Training Room Guide to help refine their skills.

But the Wildsoul class is more than just aesthetics. Wildsoul warriors channel their connection to nature through two distinct specializations: Transformation and Spirit Beast Summoning, offering an adaptable and exhilarating combat experience.

CLASS PLAYSTYLE & IDENTITY
Wild Soul is a Specialist Advanced Class that revolves around a unique three-meter identity system, enabling players to shift between Bear, Fox, and Phantom Beast Awakening forms. The class features two primary playstyles:

Phantom Beast Awakening (Swiftness/Crit–Non-Transformation Focused)
A fast-paced, high-tempo build that focuses on skill cycling and identity gauge management, allowing for near-constant uptime on powerful buffs.
 High mobility and low cooldowns, similar to Reflux Sorceress.
 Stacks Essence Buff while in the Phantom Beast Awakening form, then consumes stacks with the Identity Skill (Z) for:
[list]
[*]  Cooldown Reduction (5% per stack).
[*] Mana Recovery (2% per stack).
[*] A high-speed combat loop
[*] Fill the identity gauge.
[*] Activate Phantom Beast Awakening Form.
[*] Cycle skills rapidly. 
[*] Consume stacks for cooldown resets.
[*]  Repeat.
[/list]

Wild Instincts (Specialization/Crit–Transformation-Based)
[list]
[*]  A burst-focused playstyle that shifts between Bear and Fox forms, utilizing a powerful fourth skill mechanic for massive damage boosts.
[*] Bear Form: Tanks damage and gains damage reduction.
[*] Fox Form: Increases attack speed for faster skill execution.
[*] Every fourth skill cast within transformation receives a 40% damage boost.
[/list]
 Gameplay loop:
    [list]
[*] Alternate between Bear and Fox forms.
[*]     Build identity.
[*]     Use a fourth skill for burst.
[*]     Temporarily exit transformation to regenerate the gauge.
[*]     Repeat.
[/list]

CLASS CHARACTERISTICS

Wild Soul strikes a balance between survivability and offensive versatility, offering:

[list]
[*] Class Synergy: Applies a 12% defense reduction debuff to enemies.
[/list]
Tanky Survivability:
[list]
[*]  2.1 HP coefficient and 100% defense scaling (similar to Slayer and Artillerist).
[/list]
Innate Critical Damage Scaling:
[list]
[*] Similar to Aeromancer, Wild Soul has baked-in critical damage bonuses.
[/list]
Flexible Skill System:
[list]
[*] Similar to Breaker, Wild Soul’s skills automatically shift forms based on activation.
[/list]
Skill Types:
[list]
[*] Green Skills: Exit transformation and regenerate identity gauge.
[*] Yellow Skills: Bear Form abilities.
[*] Blue Skills: Fox Form abilities.
[/list]

Unique Identity Gauge:
[list]
[*] Tracks three meters, dynamically shifting based on the active transformation.
[*] The Phantom Beast Awakening Form lasts 30 seconds, with a stackable Essence Buff mechanic.
[/list]

A Warrior in Harmony with Nature
Wildsoul fighters are more than just skilled combatants; they are guardians of the natural order, channeling the essence of the wilderness into their every move. They strike with the precision of a predator and move with the fluidity of the wind, making them unpredictable foes and invaluable allies. Their connection to the land gives them heightened reflexes, the ability to adapt in battle, and an unmatched resilience that allows them to thrive in even the most chaotic encounters.

Transformation Specialization: This path enables the Wildsoul to morph into powerful animal forms, such as a bear or fox, each offering unique abilities and combat styles. As the Wildsoul uses transformation skills, they accumulate specific meters corresponding to each form. Building up these meters allows the player to unleash potent finishing moves, delivering devastating damage to enemies. Additionally, maintaining transformation stacks provides various buffs, including passive healing, increased attack speed, and the application of armor break synergies, enhancing both personal and party performance in battle.

Spirit Beast Summoning Specialization: In this build, the Wildsoul focuses on summoning ethereal spirit beasts to aid in combat. By utilizing spirit beast skills, players fill a unique meter that, once maxed, can be activated to enter an “Awakened” state. During this state, the Wildsoul experiences increased attack and movement speed, as well as a significant boost in critical damage. Landing spirit beast skills in this mode generates orbs that can be collected to restore mana and reset skill cooldowns, allowing for sustained offensive capabilities and strategic versatility.
These specializations offer players the flexibility to choose between direct, melee-focused combat through transformations or a more ranged, Summoner-style approach with spirit beasts, catering to diverse playstyles and strategic preferences.

No matter which path you choose, the Wildsoul is the one who defends, hunts, and dominates with the might of the untamed. Whether you stride into battle bathed in celestial light or shrouded in primal darkness, you are a force to be reckoned with.

The wild is calling. Will you answer? 

See you in Arkesia!

notes.title: Team Update - Upcoming Events & Policies
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/S6BJEfpViKePsxPCYvBfz/b657ea9d2d2d83ca08152c16185c3a45/LA_JumpStart_Gift_1920x1080_CT-002631.jpg[/img]
[h2]Heroes of Arkesia,[/h2]

We have seen a lot of community discussion over the past few months and wanted to take a moment to clarify our stance on bussing related topics and some policy adjustments. First, we’ll cover some details for the upcoming update, and then dive into policy adjustments built to make the party-finder tool a better experience.

[h3]February Updates[/h3]
[b]Wildsoul + Progression Events[/b]
The latest class— Wildsoul— will arrive alongside progression events built to support it, including a South Kurzan Powerpass, the latest Mokoko Express event, and a third event in the works (spoiler alert, expect some help with Advanced Honing). We typically see a higher volume of returning players for new class releases and progression events, and want to ensure that they are not only supported by in-game systems, but also the broader Lost Ark community.

[b]Mokoko Bootcamp[/b]
To help further teach these players the ropes, or brush up on rusty raiding skills, we are bringing back the Mokoko Bootcamp Event. Community feedback coming out of the event’s debut was extremely helpful, and something we will continue to look at coming out of the second iteration of the event. We are looking into longer-term solutions to make the event a permanent system in the game, but weren’t ready to roll out those changes in time for the Wildsoul release and progression events. This version of the Mokoko Bootcamp will include players who had not logged-in within the last 60 days, or created a new account within the last 60 days, and who are under Item Level 1670. For the more permanent solution, we will continue to evaluate what defines a Mokoko. This event will run for a few months, similar to the initial iteration (with some refreshed and updated rewards) as we continue to monitor in-game data and player feedback on our path to making it a more permanent system.

Players will notice overhauls to the rewards, including a new special “Mokoko Legion Commander” title. We saw a lot of feedback on the volume of other available rewards, and will be juicing those up to ensure the event is worthwhile to all players. And, as we know you’re curious, while the event itself will not give away a Relic Engraving Selector, there will be one arriving for players elsewhere in the February update. We hope the special chase items along with increased honing and other progression materials will make it worthwhile for all.

We’re looking forward to seeing how this event helps support new and returning players joining for the February update, and will be monitoring your feedback as we look to solidify the future of Mokoko Bootcamp.

[b]Party Finder Policy Adjustments & Reminders
[/b]Given the context discussed around supporting returning players and coupled with the return of the Mokoko Bootcamp, we will no longer permit the promotion of bussing and other services from the in-game party-finder tool. Our goal is to foster a better party-finder experience for new or returning players where they can better find learning groups with each other, or find a veteran party willing to show a Mokoko the ropes in exchange for Mokoko Bootcamp event tokens.

For the first two weeks (beginning tomorrow, February 18), players violating the new policy will receive a 15-minute suspension as a first time reminder and warning, with subsequent penalties beginning at 1 day, with escalating penalties (up to week-long and then month-long suspensions) for repeat offenses. After the two week period concludes, suspensions for violating the policy will begin at 1 day, and then follow the escalating penalties for repeat offenses. Spamming chat (such as Area Chat) with promotions will also incur the same penalty.

Bussing in Lost Ark has always been an “at your own risk” activity. Gold, items, or materials accepted from other players may be attached to a bad faith history, and subject for removal. Players may receive penalties if they receive illicit items, as it can be hard to verify the intention for payments that included gold generated from bots or past RMT, and will need to appeal the decision with appropriate evidence.

As a final note while we’re talking about making the Party Finder a more welcoming experience, we wanted to provide a reminder that offering piloting services is a serious offense and will incur corresponding penalties, including permanent bans.

[h3]Heroes of Arkesia,[/h3]

February 8 marks three years of Lost Ark in the West, and we have a variety of events and gifts planned to celebrate the Lost Ark community. We hope you have fun and celebrate with us— our goal is to thank you for your passion, dedication, feedback, and support as we continue on this journey together. We can’t state enough how much we appreciate those who have joined us on this adventure! Learn about the gifts and special events we have planned to celebrate the community in Arkesia this month, found below an infographic that shares a look back at the past year.

[b]Year 3 Recap[/b]

From the Thaemine The First Race to the launch of Tier 4, huge QoL improvements, and many more raids, events, and activities, the third year of Lost Ark in the West has been filled to the brim with new adventures. While it’s impossible to capture the magnitude of everything the Lost Ark community accomplished, we hope this encompasses some of the special moments you shared with friends and other adventurers in your journey over the last year.

Data encompasses player activity from February 1, 2024 to January 31, 2025. Data from banned bot accounts has been removed from the statistics.

We can’t wait to celebrate another year of Lost Ark with you, so get ready to party in Arkesia!

notes.title: Lost Ark 2025 Roadmap - Part 1
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/EejTfQIoRy87VLZFdt4G4/5d4f74100edde328f444f11a4107951e/EN_LA_Roadmap_Part_1_1920x1080.jpg[/img]

Heroes of Arkesia,

We’re excited to share a first look at December and the first few months of next year with the first part of the 2025 Roadmap! Join Lost Ark team members Henry and Roxx for a discussion of the key content arriving in December 2024 through March 2025. 

The roadmap content discussed are highlights we know players are eagerly awaiting, but the roadmap is not a comprehensive list of every change arriving in Arkesia over the next few months, and could change. As we approach each month, more details will be shared. Stay tuned to our website and social channels for future Release Notes, including the full list of new content, cosmetics, content balance changes, events, and more included in our major monthly updates.

[previewyoutube=dk1j5pqoiSk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]December 2024[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/2RR8Tg4UPLYH9TAE0q8v38/653230bf9c996305cfcfb0e20f4a16c7/LA_Roadmap_DEC_1920x1080.jpg[/img]

There are some big changes coming in December alongside their releases in Korea that we’re excited to reveal. The full release notes will arrive on December 17 with the full details and content arriving this month. The following list is a summary of key updates. 

[h3]Solo Mode Update[/h3]
Prepare to challenge notorious threats solo for the first time, with the Thaemine Legion Raid and Echidna Kazeros Raid added to the roster of raids available in Solo Mode.

An update to Solo Mode will also be added, including a new buff system and cost reductions to the “View More Rewards”.

[h3]Kazeros Raid: Act 2 Prologue[/h3]
The prologue quest covers the story of how the Allied Forces begins a new strategy to overcome the current situation for the ongoing war in North Kurzan. As you progress through the prologue quest, you will learn the new strategy of the Allied Forces and after fighting Aegir, as we head toward the battle against Narok and Brelshaza.

[h3]Elixir & Transcendence Adjustments[/h3]
[list][*] The Elixir progression system has been overhauled to make Elixir transmutation faster and less strategic to simplify the experience.
[*] The Transcendence system has been overhauled to simplify the progression path.[/list]

[h3]Proving Grounds Season 6[/h3]
Proving Ground Season 6 will begin in December. Prove you’re one of the best warriors in Arkesia to earn season ranks, rewards, and prestige in Season 6 of competitive Proving Grounds.

[h3]Icy Breakthrough Event[/h3]
A new mission-based progression event arrives, built to help players progress through the beginning of Tier 4. It’s a great continuation of the ongoing Hyper Awakening Road Event, and will help with progression in early Tier 4. There are four categories of missions:
[list][*] Weapon Honing
[*] Armor Honing
[*] Clearing Echidna Gates
[*] Clearing Behemoth Gates[/list]
The honing missions will grant Hellfire Honing Books and Gold as you hone your gear over Item Level 1640. The Echidna missions will grant Agris’ Scales, Alcaone’s Eye, and additional support materials, and the Behemoth missions will grant Behemoth’s Scales and Weapon Transcendence Restoration Tickets.

[h2]January 2025[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/5NKbjIBvZ3rTNbJkfpc3f8/7a9ff158c84e0b79f263d4d2ebddfb81/LA_Roadmap_JAN_1920x1080.jpg[/img]

[h3]Kazeros Raid Act 2: Requiem of the Floating Nightmare[/h3]
Face off against Brelshaza once more in Kazeros Raid Act 2: Requiem of the Floating Nightmare. This raid will require 8-players, and take place in a harsh, icy battleground, which provides the perfect backdrop for Brelshaza’s own chilling new powers. In Gate 1, the Valley of Piercing Screams, you’ll have to fight the intimidating Narok the Butcher, and in Gate 2, Phantom Apeiron, you’ll see the familiar Brelshaza with some new abilities. This raid will also introduce the Karma System, which will allow players to receive new ways to power up their characters. Normal Mode will be available at Item level 1670, and Hard Mode will be available at Item Level 1690.

We will include the latest improvements to the raid applied in Korea, such as showing targeting effect during certain patterns in Gate 1.

Along with Brelshaza, a host of new Tier 4 content will arrive, including the release of Tier 4 Bracelets, a new Guardian, Abidos Operation, a Chaos Gate for players over Item Level 1680, and the 2nd Unlock of the T4 Ebony Cube.

[h3]Frontier System[/h3]
When the frontier system is applied, raid difficulty (damage and HP) will decrease for raid bosses as stage of the frontier progresses. The stages progress automatically as time goes on. With the frontier system, parties clearing cutting-edge content can enjoy a similar difficulty to Korea when the raid releases, and others can enjoy an easier version as time passes; making the raid more approachable for more casual players while also lessening the reclear difficulty. 

[h3]Third Anniversary Celebration[/h3]
Lost Ark Anniversary celebrations will kick off a little bit early this year, coming in with our update at the end of January. This will allow us to get celebrating sooner, and pave the way for an exciting release in February. Celebrate Lost Ark’s Anniversary in a new anniversary event, the “Festa of Arkesia” on a special Anniversary island. Here you’ll get to participate in exclusive quests, receive rewards, and also see some familiar faces. 

[h2]February 2025[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/4Xl6sKWk0vLlqhEQQnM87o/79a6f6b9b71adee3a8e3b17cd92457e5/LA_Roadmap_FEB_1920x1080.jpg[/img]

[h3]Wild Soul Advanced Class[/h3]
The next Advanced Class is a Yoz Specialist class— a versatile character that can transform into animals or use their scroll to fight with spirit beast spells while in human form. The class will invoke a blend of energy that feels both animalistic and mystical in nature. For example, the class can transform into forms like a bear, or into the form of a Kumiho, a nine-tailed fox. The Yoz tribe specializes in harnessing the power of illusions, and the Wild Soul can also summon spirits, such as birds or foxes, to fight alongside them.

[h3]Progression Events[/h3]
The Wild Soul Advanced Class will be accompanied by progression events. More details will be provided headed toward the release of the new class.

[h2]March 2025[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/2BVa2RGkkWDfgDryLuC6Il/ca4aa22e07a82f4b0205d3e2f7e84d57/LA_Roadmap_MAR_1920x1080.jpg[/img]

With a ton of major content releasing in the first few months of 2025, we’ve still got more planning to do for March and the later months. Right now, we are planning on releasing the next Music Box of Memories unlock during March, and continuing the progression events to support the release of the Wild Soul Advanced Class in February. We’ll see what else is in store once we reach next year! 

[h2]Looking Ahead[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/2ve9yHIbOXGmX12dX5WcA/d7f4c81d8cdbf17efecfd82209089228/LA_Gate_Map_01_1920x1080.jpg[/img]

Our team is excited to finish 2024 with a swathe of progression and solo mode updates in December, an enormous endgame update in January with the next Kazeros Raid, and an exciting few months when the Wild Soul Advanced Class and new progression events arrive.

In the meantime, stay tuned to our website, social channels, and each month’s Release Notes for the full list of new content, store updates, events, bug fixes, and more over the coming months. Head over to YouTube to let us know your thoughts on the video component of the roadmap, and if you’d like to see this type of content heading forward. We’ll see you in Arkesia!

notes.title: October 30 Release Notes
notes.content:
Heroes of Arkesia,

During weekly maintenance a new event will be added and Server Transfers will be enabled for Ignite players to move to Legacy Servers. Downtime will begin on October 30 at 12am PT (7am UTC) and is expected to last 5 hours. Learn about the new event and transfer experience below.

[h3]Mokoko Bootcamp Event[/h3]
The Mokoko Bootcamp Event runs from October 30th to January 15th, 2025 and is designed to encourage veteran players to play dungeons with new or returning players. New and returning players whose highest Item Level character on their account is below Item Level 1660 can earn "Mokoko Tokens" for completing dungeons during the event period. These new and returning players will have a "green leaf" icon in the recruitment panel. Green leaf Mokoko players will be those who meet one of the following conditions:
[list][*] A new account that has been created within the event period
[*] Accounts that have been created within 60 days before the event start date
[*] Accounts with a previous Login Date over 60 days before the event start date[/list]
Once a player acquires the “green leaf”, it will persist until the end of the event, but will expire when any of the characters in that player’s account is over Item Level 1660.

Veteran players, defined as active players not belonging to the categories above, can earn "Expert Tokens" when they complete dungeons together with the new/returning players. Both the Mokoko Tokens and Expert Tokens can then be exchanged for rewards, with the number of Tokens earned varying based on which specific dungeons are completed. As long as there is at least one new/returning player in the group, the entire team qualifies to earn the respective Tokens.

The reward tables will be slightly different for new players and returning players, but both reward tables will have both weekly and once-per-roster items. Both groups will have access to honing materials and even Metallurgy/Tailoring: Hellfire honing books to help hone in Tier 4. Mokoko Tokens will better help newer players get caught up on things like cards and other methods of progression. The Expert Tokens will grant endgame items, including a Relic Engraving Selection chest, and a “Mokoko General” title with a special icon title for helping new players out!

[h3]Ignite Server Transfer[/h3]
The transfer window allowing Ignite players to transfer a single character to Legacy servers will open with the update, and will remain open until November 25. There are two types of transfers:
Roster Transfer (better for new players) - move some roster level information to a server without an existing roster, along with the chosen character.
Character Transfer (better for returning or active players) - merge your chosen Ignite character into an existing roster.

To view what will (or will not) transfer with each type of transfer, visit our [url=https://www.playlostark.com/ignite-servers-merge-policy]Ignite Servers Merge Policy Page[/url].

We’re excited to welcome new and returning Ignite players to Legacy Servers as reinforcements in the fight against Kazeros. New threats will be able to be challenged in the North Kurzan storyline, Behemoth Epic Raid, and the Echidna and Aegir Kazeros Raids. In the meantime, we’ll see you in Arkesia!

notes.title: Team Update: Addressing the Reward Exploit
notes.content:
Heroes of Arkesia,

A bug was identified with Ignite reward chests, which some players were able to repeatedly exploit. Our team has been investigating the extent of the issue, and wanted to communicate our decision on the penalty for those who abused the exploit. As a reminder, a key tenet of the Amazon Games Code of Conduct is to “Play Fair”. We reserve the right to determine what constitutes unfair play and to take corrective action we deem appropriate, and the abuse of this exploit will have corrective action taken, with suspensions and bans already sent out. 

[h3]General Policy[/h3]
Slightly over 2,300 players received rewards chests from the Ignite Stronghold reward issue. Within this group, over 1,200 did not open any of the reward chests. The group that did not open any reward chests will not have any action taken against their accounts apart from removing the unopened chests from their inventory. For the remaining 1,000 players who opened the reward chests, the severity of the penalty will directly correspond to the level of bug exploitation. At a base level, all items will be removed and skill tree levels will be rolled back. For items that were used and cannot be removed, players may have gold (or the gold value of the used items) deducted from their balance, or be sent into the negatives corresponding to the severity of the abuse. This policy will apply to all materials, including processed chaos stones and combined honing materials. Along with the item withdrawals, players will be receiving suspensions and bans matching their level of exploit.

The first group are players who may have mistakenly encountered the issue and did not repeatedly abuse the bug. Players who opened 1 or 2 chests will have any items withdrawn and have not been suspended/banned at this time. Our team is investigating if we can remove the items for this group during maintenance. If the item removal process is gauged to take longer than the maintenance period, this group of players will receive a short suspension to give our team the time needed to remove the items. Spending these items in the meantime will result in further action, such as gold removal.

Players who continually exploited the issue and opened multiple reward chests will have more severe action taken, corresponding to their level of exploit. 
[list][*] Players that opened 3 - 7 chests will receive a two-week suspension.
[*] Players that opened 8 - 14 chests will receive a 1-month suspension.
[*] Players that opened 15+ chests will receive a notice that they have received a 30-day suspension and are pending further review. This group will have various levels of action taken, up to permanent bans from the game.[/list]

[h3]Issue Resolution[/h3]
To stop exploitation of the main reward issue and other bugs, access to strongholds was disabled. For players who have a character stuck in a stronghold, and need access to that character immediately, please submit a customer support ticket. Otherwise, the issue will be resolved during maintenance for the October 23 update. We will also re-enable the use of the Ignite reward chests at this time for players on Ignite Servers. 



Based on our policies and investigation, we believe this is the best course of action. We know many players were concerned about the outcome, and we wanted to be clear with our approach. In the future, if you encounter an issue you believe is an exploit or unintended issue, do not engage with the issue (no matter how tempting it may seem) and report it to our teams. We appreciate those who reported the issue, along with your patience while members our team investigated and blocked access to certain in-game systems. While this issue gained high visibility in the community, we hope this policy is clear and allows us to move forward together. We are always open to community feedback, and welcome you to engage in the conversation on our official channels.

There are still key moments coming to Arkesia this week, with Aegir’s arrival and Ignite Server transfers arriving. Those aren’t the only things arriving in the update— stay tuned for the full release notes on Tuesday. In the meantime, we’ll see you in Arkesia.

notes.title: Ignite Learning Resources
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/3CprKqzaX7olbrLAH8sfNm/7ca1a4a7d6c1f75cafde2d2c9bb57ed4/la-02-web.jpg[/img]

Heroes of Arkesia,

Embarking on a new adventure in Arkesia — or picking up where you left off — to join the fight against Kazeros can be a daunting task. There are many systems and activities to learn that all weave together to power up your character and build your in-game skills as you move to challenge bigger and badder threats. Learn about some of the ways to learn from current legends, returning content creators, or uncover where many members of the Lost Ark community find key information and guides on Lost Ark Nexus and Maxroll.

[h3]Ignite Server Overview[/h3]
To bolster the ranks of players ready to enter Tier 4, a special progression event arrives in the form of Ignite Servers. These accelerated servers will quickly level players up to 1620 and give them the tools to enter the fray, joining veteran players in the campaign against Kazeros. We’ll guide you through the Ignite Server experience and how you or your friends joining the fight will be prepared for the challenges to come. 

Haven’t learned the basics of Ignite Servers yet? Make sure you check out the [url=https://www.playlostark.com/news/articles/ignite-servers-overview]Ignite Servers - Join the Fight article.[/url]

[h1]Creator Ignite Program[/h1]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/1JbmydeloLavwpDs1R1Q0e/1c32ff13dbf4f343bc6ef32523da5f7a/LA_Arkesia_Ignited_Release_Note_Images_HyperAwakening_Sorceress_v01_1080.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Program Overview[/h3]
To help guide you through your journey, we’ve partnered with a group of current and returning Lost Ark content creators to guide you through the experience week-over-week. Tune in every day on reset day (every Wednesday) throughout October to watch them complete raids, talk through progression systems, and experience Ignite Servers.

Ignite Servers will be live from October 9 - November 27, with server transfers opening on October 23. The Twitch creators listed below will be creating content built to help guide new or returning players through the Ignite Server experience. Tune in for tips, tricks, special Twitch Drops, in-game item code giveaways, or to get involved in the Lost Ark community!

[h3]Participants[/h3]
The following returning and current Lost Ark content creators will be your guides on how to get up-to-speed.
[list][*] Moxsy
[*] Sneakylol
[*] Stoopzz
[*] Saintone
[*] Savix
[*] Laufielol
[*] Cauttyh
[*] ZealsAmbitions
[*] Johnpal
[*] MisoxShiru
[*] Strylander[/list]
[h3]Twitch Drops[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/7KWcymNyCg5f8aiq3x4GuW/e10747d29423b14b64559060766f76d3/LA_CreatorIgnite_TwitchDrop_Web_1920x1080_CT-000012766.jpg[/img]

Participants in the Creator Ignite program will have special Twitch Drops enabled on their channels across 2 active campaigns. One for viewers who will be playing on Ignite servers, another for players on Legacy worlds. There are up to four Drops per campaign, and unlike tiered Drops, watch time for each Drop is earned simultaneously. Watch time will accumulate across all viewed streams, and the drops are built to provide a small boost in a few different areas of Lost Ark— as Ignite Servers will have you covered on progression materials. From Engravings to horizontal content like Rapport, and even a pet cosmetic, there’s something for every Lost Ark player in these drops!

[h1]Recommended Learning Resources[/h1]

Uncover where many members of the Lost Ark community finds their key information and guides on 
Lost Ark Nexus and Maxroll.

[h3]Maxroll[/h3]
The Lost Ark section of Maxroll is overflowing with guides and resources designed to help you uncover the secrets of Arkesia. The guides are streamlined, and make good use of tooltips and embeds to deliver a comprehensive experience catered towards casual and new players.

[url=https://maxroll.gg/lost-ark]Maxroll - Lost Ark Section[/url]

From comprehensive guides such as their [url=https://maxroll.gg/lost-ark/resources/beginners-and-returners-guide]Beginner’s and Returner’s Guide[/url] to [url=https://maxroll.gg/lost-ark/raids]Raid guides[/url] and much more — Maxroll likely has what you’re looking for.

[h3]Lost Ark Nexus[/h3]
“Lost Ark Nexus is the beginning of your journey towards in-game mastery. We offer a collection of guides that are hand crafted and consistently maintained by various class mentors, theory crafters, and members of the community.”

[url=https://www.lostark.nexus/]Lost Ark Nexus[/url]

The detailed community class build guides found on Nexus will help you pick a playstyle, or learn how to maximize your potential — while the other curated guides and resources are built to teach you about a variety of key Lost Ark systems, or even try them out to practice before you need to use them in-game! 

[h3]Looking Ahead[/h3]
We look forward to seeing all types of players grow in power to face Kazeros and his Demon Legions and encourage you to use all the tools at your disposal to prepare for battle. Getting involved in the Lost Ark community is a great way to learn — join our [url=https://discord.gg/playlostark]Official Discord Server[/url] to find others to play with, get involved in the Twitch Community of Creator Ignite streamers, or forge new friendships using the in-game guilds or social systems. We wish you luck in your adventures, and we’ll see you in Arkesia!

notes.title: Arkesia Ignited Release Notes
notes.content:

The Arkesia Ignited Update arrives on October 9, heralding the beginning of a new age for new and veteran players alike. The time for the Allied Forces to gather in North Kurzan and unite in battle against Kazeros’ demonic legions has arrived. The battle in North Kurzan will serve as the entry point to Tier 4 (T4), Lost Ark’s endgame evolution, which introduces a multitude of new endgame systems for players to power up before facing the many challenges on the near horizon.

The vast array of new gear, systems, and abilities aren’t the only thing that will help you power up to face Kazeros’ forces — reinforcements are also critical to overcoming the demonic hordes. To bolster the ranks of players ready to enter Tier 4, a special progression event arrives in the form of Ignite Servers. These special servers will quickly level players up to 1620 and give them the tools to enter the fray. Additionally, to give players a major power increase in Tier 4, Hyper Awakenings will also be included in this update!

Downtime will begin on October 9 at 12 a.m. PT (7 a.m. UTC) and is expected to last 15 hours. notes.title: Gear Up For Aegir
notes.content:
Heroes of Arkesia, 

The Arkesia Ignited Update arrives on October 9, heralding a new age for new and veteran players alike. The time for the Allied Forces to gather in North Kurzan and unite in battle against Kazeros’ demonic legions will soon begin.

This 2-gate Kazeros Raid will require you to face off against dangerous threats, with Akkan returning for a fight in the first Gate, and Aegir appearing as your foe in the second Gate.

notes.title: Weekly Update & Behemoth Buster Gift
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/2wk5KY6LE2BpdR3Ts9I2VD/d2ac7e39aa014e2454c53dd8cb3de5c8/LA_Behemoth_01_1920x1080.jpg[/img]

Heroes of Arkesia, 

All Lost Ark servers and regions will be taken offline on Wednesday, September 25, 2024 at 12:00 AM PT for our weekly maintenance. During this time, additional adjustments will be made to EAC. Downtime is estimated to last up to 4 hours. 

Following the maintenance period, all players will receive a gift in their product inventories to help them continue through the Transcendence System as Tier 4 approaches! We’ve seen a lot of feedback from the community and reviewed player data surrounding the western balance changes to Behemoth. With the changes to Transcendence and Elixirs that also arrived with the ‘Chase The Storm’ update, we’ve seen feedback that newer 1620 characters are struggling with damage contribution or are being gatekept due to their Transcendence level. While Behemoth is clearable with a party of 1620s, we wanted to provide a gift to help players juice their characters up for the raid in response to the feedback we’ve seen. We looked into slightly tweaking the balance, but Tier 4’s imminent arrival on October 9 will provide an immediate and substantial Item Level boost for 1620 characters using the gear transfer system. We would rather you feel powered-up with lasting effects, such as some help progressing through the Transcendence System. We also hope that the in-game Chase The Storm event continues to help you power up your roster. To support that goal, the “Behemoth Buster” player gift will contain the following:
[list][*] 30 Armor Transcendence Restoration Tickets
[*] 10 Weapon Transcendence Restoration Tickets
[*] [Masterwork] Master's Herb Steaks[/list]

notes.title: August 28 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Heroes of Arkesia,

This weekly update includes a variety of balance changes for the Akkan and Thaemine Legion Raids, along with the Echidna Kazeros Raid. There are a few general changes and bug fixes included alongside the raid balance changes. Downtime will begin on August 28 at 12 a.m. PT (7 a.m. UTC) and is expected to last 4 hours.

[h1]Akkan Updates[/h1]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/1ad7w2q7qIqylIH74MWPF5/3cc73e3572c435fd2022190693a57359/LA_Aug_Press_Screenshots_Legion_Commander_Akkan_001_1080__1_.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Gate 1[/h3]
Normal & Solo Mode
[list][*] Lowered the damage dealt to players during the 'Safe Zone' Mech when Maurug throws his spear.
[*] Reduced the amount of HP Maurug recovers per failed shield destruction.
[*] Reduced the effect of 'Corrosion' and 'Plague Wound' debuffs that Maurug uses.
[*] Reduced the damage Maurug deals to players after imprisoning.[/list]
Normal Mode
[list][*] The 'Safe Zone' Mech when Maurug throws one or two spears changed to only throw two spears.
[*] Lowered the stagger damage required during the Stagger check mechanic when players have to purify the 'Weakened Plague Assimilation' debuff.[/list]
[h3]Gate 2[/h3]
Normal & Solo Mode
[list][*] Decreased the amount of Plague meter gained when getting hit by Akkan.
[*] Changed the damage-dealing mechanism for 'Hiding in the Shadows' mechanic. Players will now receive increased damage for every time they fail to follow the shadow correctly.
[*] In the lantern relay (keep-away) pattern, the 'Fear' debuff given by the monster 'Decaying Kin' will be shorter.
[*] Removed the 'Paralysis' effect from some of the patterns in the Zero HP mechanic.[/list]
Normal Mode
[list][*] Changed the damage-dealing mechanism when Akkan disappears to swing his Scythe to a random player. Now a player receives critical damage when hit by the same pattern twice.
[*] Increased the time for counter-attacking Akkan's phantom doppleganger in the Zero HP mechanic[/list]
[h3]Gate 3[/h3]
Normal & Solo Mode
[list][*] Greatly decreased the damage of black lasers shooting from statues in the rotating statues mechanic.
[*] Slightly increased the time available for counter-attacks.[/list]
Normal Mode
[list][*] Decreased the amount of Plague meter increased when battling Akkan.
[*] Decreased the amount of damage dealt when hit by the Guillotine blades in the 4-way stagger mechanic.
[*] Decreased the 'Slow' debuff when connected to the purple line in the 'Soul Absorption' mechanic, and changed some of the patterns to deal 'Paralysis' instead of 'Pushed'.
[*] The respawn time for plague spores on the map has greatly increased.
[*] In the 'Curse' mechanic which can summon one of three colors, the black curse no longer appears.
[*] Changed Akkan's Scythe damage to gradually increase based on times hit in the 'Peekaboo' pattern when Akkan disappears to swing his Scythe to an incapacitated player.
[*] Decreased the max HP of zombie players.[/list]
[h1]Echidna Updates[/h1]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/6YlnlVnHGZw8EUJjasK4jd/538397d16fbebeb111dff03b3020172d/LA_Roadmap_June_KeyArt_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
[h3]Gate 1[/h3]
Normal & Hard Mode
[list][*] Decreased the amount of damage from the Dragon’s overhead flame attacks, and prevent players from falling when they get hit.
[*] The Demon Legion now only invades 2 times (instead of 3) during the battle with Narkiel.
[*] After the advent of Agris, we have increased the range that Censer can be detected in the pattern where Censer has to be found.[/list]
Hard Mode
[list][*] In the final battle with Narkiel, manipulating the Censer now creates a red aura around the player’s body to make it a little easier to know the condition of not being able to manipulate the Censer.[/list]
[h3]Gate 2[/h3]
Normal & Hard Mode
[list][*] Echidna's HP has been decreased.
[*] The damage of seduced players decreased.
[*] Modified effect of "Whispers of Seduction" and "Dominance of Seduction" debuffs.
[*] Modified Debuff duration of "Whispers of Seduction" from 60 seconds to 30 seconds.
[*] Players will no longer be hit by basic attacks of friendly NPCs created by Allied Forces Skills during the "Whispers of Seduction" debuff.
[*] We have reduced the number of attacks to release a player from the debuff "Petrification" by 50%.
[*] Updated the debuff "Petrification" so that players don't die if their release is failed.
[*] When players fail the pattern of having to hit the energy sphere fired from the mirror to Echidna during the battle, it no longer raid wipes immediately, but instead wipes the raid when it fails twice.
[*] Increased the cycle timing when flytraps are created by Echidna.
[*] Decreased the amount of damage from the patterns where players should or should not look at the boss during the battle with the giant Echidna.
[*] Players no longer die when failing a clash during the battle of Echidna in the underground space, but instead receive massive damage.
[*] When Echidna's gauge fills during the battle in the underground space and snakes try to reach Echidna, the number of attacks to kill the snake have decreased by 20%. Additionally, red snakes don’t come out anymore.[/list]
Hard Mode
[list][*] In the pattern where players need to link the energy sphere fired from the mirror to Echidna during the battle, small flowers will no longer be produced when two characters stand on top of one tile.
[*] When Echidna's HP reaches zero in the underground battle, the catch pattern was modified so that the snake's sign could be seen by others, rather than just the caught player, when using the catch pattern.
[*] In the underground battle, the "silence" debuff is now released quickly in the "jump-rope" pattern (where players avoid the slow-spreading red wavelength).[/list]
[h1]Thaemine Updates[/h1]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/6t0m2AM14qmrCydBqpNLo8/d03a48574b0f7ed92afc4406b7749bc1/LA_Thaemine_Prelude_Screenshots_B_Final_1080_CT-000005777.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Gate 1[/h3]
[list][*] When Killineza the Dark Worshipper inflicts a status effect and grabs the player, this status effect attack will no longer affect players with status effect immunity.[/list]
Hard Mode 
[list][*] Killineza the Dark Worshipper can now die at the same time as Normal Mode (before the large eye pattern).[/list]
[h3]Gate 2[/h3]
Hard Mode
[list][*] Valinak, Herald of the End will no longer recover HP after certain patterns.[/list]
[h3]Gate 3[/h3]
[list][*] Reduced the difficulty of Clash mini-game. This update arrived in an earlier build, but is part of the overall update to Thaemine’s difficulty.
[*] Increased the number of safe zones remaining in the combat area at the time of the attack when Thaemine the Lightqueller has a pattern where he gradually removes safe zones from the combat area and unleashes a powerful attack.
[*] Adjusted the attack range of Thaemine the Lightqueller's attack pattern of quickly moving forward/backward while swinging his sword, so that players will not take damage from behind Thaemine.[/list]
[h1]General & Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*] Players can now use an Event Powerpass without having Trusted status. Our team will review data, feedback, and any impact to decide any next steps, along with any adjustments to the Trusted system.
[*] Fixed an issue where Equipping "Essential Loose Fit Pants" skin piece changes the appearance of certain items and skins on the Female Martial Artist class.
[*] Fixed an issue where occasionally the texture for Indigo Island's Whirlpool was missing.
[*] Fixed two minor Market UI issues.[/list]

notes.title: Team Update - Roadmap Adjustment
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/59Hd7N9ALxmEBJjT55s5HR/1776840b13557ec62eda5d81e935c380/LA_Roadmap_SEP_KeyArt_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
Heroes of Arkesia,

Earlier this month we shared a first look at our upcoming roadmap and plans to release the next evolution of Lost Ark in the shape of Tier 4, along with new raids and many other key updates. Today, we have a few key updates to that plan. From thousands of lines of text in our supported languages to the accompanying voice lines, there’s a lot that goes into preparing major updates for their release into Arkesia’s Western shores. We’ve hit a small delay in our localization timeline, but we’re excited to share an update to the plan that we built in collaboration with Smilegate RPG during our recent trip to Korea, which factors in player feedback we’ve seen since announcing the roadmap.

If you’ve been playing recently, you probably noticed that the Super Mokoko Express (and other key events) are set to draw to a close on September 25, and likely had a suspicion that was the planned release date for Tier 4. You would’ve been correct, and we’re going to use that date as a reference point for the updated plan. With that context, let’s take a look at the updated plan for September and October.

[h2]September Update[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/5Kxa4VvGyn2Uad4o2efb9Q/a22aa842c8838d554798932800f56893/LA_Behemoth_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
[h3]Behemoth Raid - September 11[/h3]
With a limited pool of revives available, prepare for mayhem as you attempt to fell the enormous dragon and earn Gold, honing materials, and Weapon Transcendence materials. We will release the 16-player Behemoth raid earlier than planned (in Tier 3) and reduce the Item Level requirement to 1620, allowing you to get a head start on the characters you plan on bringing to Tier 4. Behemoth will drop Tier 3 honing materials upon its release.

Releasing Behemoth in Tier 3 will allow players additional time to work on Weapon Transcendence and have a new challenge to undertake before the vast amount of new experiences arriving in Tier 4. Additionally, when Tier 4 drops, players will be able to focus on completing North Kurzan and familiarizing themselves with the massive amount of new content, which we think will be a better overall experience for the Lost Ark community.

Along with Behemoth, Arktoberfest will return and grant you with important progression materials items such as Oreha Fusion materials, Transcendence Restoration tickets, and Elixirs (potent), along with a few seasonal themed items. Arktoberfest Event Coins will be earnable through normal daily activities— so we hope this event continues to help you prepare for Tier 4 without requiring additional steps.

[h2]October Updates[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/2tscxvKmOILI3UrTueZHJV/e69cb5aff6ea9033dbf372656eb2b787/LA_Roadmap_OCT_KeyArt_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
October will feature two updates, planned to release two weeks apart. The current progression events will be updated to end with the release of the first update on October 9, instead of the current September 25 date.

[h3]Tier 4 Release - October 9[/h3]
Tier 4’s release will be delayed by two weeks to ensure our localization teams are able to fully translate the new stories and systems in all of our supported languages. While we know that the two-week delay will be disappointing for those already prepared to experience new adventures in Tier 4, we hope that having additional time battling Behemoth to earn Weapon Transcendence materials, two extra weeks of Gold income, and additional time to complete the progression events will help the majority of players feel better prepared for their journey into Tier 4.

Apart from Behemoth, everything announced for the September Update will now release on October 9.

We’ve also decided to rename “Express Servers” to Ignite Servers to avoid confusion with Super Mokoko Express passes, which will continue to be a recurring system in Lost Ark. Our goal with these servers are to ignite the spark of new players and give them the tools needed to join the fight against Kazeros quickly. We are preparing a new system on ignite servers that will make it easier for players to get familiar with the game and efficiently grow in power, before moving their character off ignite and into a legacy server. This system will be brand new to Lost Ark and first introduced in the NA/EU version of the game before anywhere else. Heading toward the release of Ignite Servers we’ll share more information on the events and user experience— we’re still working to ensure that these servers include everything a new or returning player will need to prepare for battle, and the specifics may change.

[h3]Aegir Raid - October 16[/h3]
Aegir will be the next Kazeros Raid, releasing a week after Tier 4. This 2-gate Raid will require players to face off against dangerous threats, with Akkan returning for a fight in the first Gate, and Aegir appearing as your foe in the second Gate. The Aegir Raid will reward players Tier 4 Ancient Gear, which can be honed further than Relic gear to help activate the Ark Passive system.

We will be monitoring player progression as we approach October, and may release Aegir on October 23 depending on the progression status of end-game players. We know that this date is important to many of you, and will share a confirmation ahead of time.

[h2]Looking Ahead[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/X52EJoQFLtjXl4oxtgvXT/91d2787657124daab16002dd51c9e251/Creator-Activation-1080.jpg[/img]
Before Behemoth arrives, we still plan to introduce nerfs to Akkan, Thaemine, and Echidna on August 28 (the first of which snuck into the August Update build). Additionally, we know there are still many conversations in the community around the recent changes to bound gold and progression systems such as Elixirs and Transcendence. We are continuing to monitor feedback and data surrounding the recent updates to all of these systems, and will work to bring any changes announced in Korea as soon as possible.

Our team is also working on some other long-term projects we’re excited to share more detail about in the coming months, such as releasing the API for the Western version of Lost Ark— something we know players have long been wondering about. We are also investigating an update to ensure that player progression is not locked behind completing the Hard version of a raid for certain types of progression systems. While the additional challenge should provide additional rewards, we also want to ensure players are still able to progress through systems if they are able to vanquish the normal version of a raid.

Our teams at Amazon Games and Smilegate RPG are dedicated to continually improving the experience in Arkesia, and appreciate both the feedback and support we’ve seen from the Lost Ark community. Have feedback for our teams? Let us know in the Official Lost Ark Discord, our social channels such as X, or stay on the lookout for surveys. Many recent adjustments and some of the changes detailed in this plan are directly influenced from recent feedback threads and surveys. If you have ideas, make sure to participate in the conversation and Lost Ark community!

We can’t wait for the stories, challenges, and more that await this fall with the arrival of Behemoth, North Kurzan, Tier 4, Aegir, and more. In the meantime, we’ll see you in Arkesia, preparing for the adventures to come.

notes.title: July 24 Weekly Update Notes
notes.content:
Heroes of Arkesia,

This week, our standard Wednesday maintenance will have a bigger batch of changes than a standard weekly update. We’re excited in incorporate some key progression changes based on player feedback! Downtime will begin on July 24 at 12 a.m. PT (7 a.m. UTC) and is expected to last up to 4 hours.

Before we dive into the updates, we’re excited to share that all players will be granted a 2024 Swimsuit Skin! We appreciate your ongoing support and passion for Lost Ark, and hope this helps you relax in the Arkesian sun during the summer months as we head toward Tier 4. We’ll let you know when this has been delivered to your Product Inventory, stay tuned to our social channels or the Official Lost Ark Discord.

[h3]General Updates[/h3]
[list][*] Elixir System: New feature to select an option for the last slot when refining an Elixir has been added, along with an option to skip Sage's cutscenes.
[*] Transcendence System: Conditions required to increase Elzowin's Grace level have been eased and added an option to speed up the Transcendence animation.
[*] Solo Raids: Honing material rewards increased and True Supporter buff improved.[/list]
[h3]Super Mokoko Express[/h3]
The Super Mokoko Express Event will be changed to allow the event to be activated on any character under item level 1620. After the conclusion of this maintenance, any players who have already picked a character for the event will be able to re-initiate the event in-game and pick a new (or the same) character to activate it on. Please note that any rewards already collected from the Super Mokoko Express Event will not be granted a second time following the update. You will still receive the event honing buffs on the character you choose, and will be able to earn any rewards that you did not already earn on the newly selected character. 

Thank you for your feedback and support! We’ll see you in Arkesia.

notes.title: Team Update - June 2024 Plans
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/6YlnlVnHGZw8EUJjasK4jd/538397d16fbebeb111dff03b3020172d/LA_Roadmap_June_KeyArt_1920x1080.jpg[/img]

Heroes of Arkesia,

We wanted to take a moment and provide an update on our plans for two important things arriving next month; the upcoming region merge and Ladon/Echidna.

[h2]Region Merge Update[/h2]
In a team update earlier this year we shared our plans to merge several regions for players to grow, play, and explore Arkesia together in Summer of 2024. On June 5, 2024, we will begin this process by merging South America into North America East.

For NA West, we are still searching the best solution to ensure the lowest latency possible for all players. Unfortunately, we found issues that would prevent a good customer experience during the extensive testing we conducted. Identifying an optimal outcome will take time, and this merge will not take place in Summer of 2024. We wish we could provide a firmer update on when we could move forward with connecting these regions, but we have not yet identified a path to do so. Our current plan is to proceed with merging South America into NA East on June 5, and to continue investigating options to combine the merged region with NA West in a way that provides the best player experience possible for all.
Next week, we’ll share the Region Merge policy and what players in the South America and North America East can expect when they merge.

[h2]Localization Update[/h2]
When our teams first uncovered the name Echidna many years ago, the final form of the original Covetous Legion Commander hadn’t yet been fully revealed— so it was changed to a related figure in Mythology; Ladon. After reviewing Echidna’s presentation in Lost Ark and reading through community feedback, we agree that the name Echidna is best suited for the alluring and deadly enemy in the first Kazeros Raid arriving June 2024. We will be working to update the name from Ladon to Echidna for her release. There may be a few places where we can’t change previous messaging, such as the video component of Part 2 of the 2024 Roadmap— but rest assured— the official name is now Echidna. Interested in learning more about Echidna and the upcoming Kazeros Raid? Checkout [url=https://www.playlostark.com/news/articles/2024-roadmap-part-2]Part 2 of the 2024 Roadmap[/url] or stay tuned our website and social channels for more information.

Thank you for your continued passion and feedback! We’ll see you in Arkesia.

notes.title: Thaemine The First Race
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/3Q1puSHDDtKpYN8eUQGV0J/3339c4a40f06ff9b3f5acf8e107f468f/LA_Thaemine_Announcement_Screenshots_Final_B_1080_CT-000005867.jpeg[/img]

Heroes of Arkesia,

With the arrival of Thaemine The First in the Darkness Unleashed Update, players can soon race to clear the most powerful Demon Commander and carve their name into Arkesian history. Thaemine The First is a special race to clear the original— and hardest— difficulty of the Thaemine Legion Raid. Clearing will be a challenge, even for the most experienced adventurers. But with extreme challenge comes prestige, and we have a variety of prestigious rewards planned for those who can vanquish Thaemine in his most powerful form. The race for Thaemine The First will begin on April 20 at 10AM PT (5PM UTC) for parties who have cleared Hard Mode. Learn more about the details and conditions in the [url=https://www.playlostark.com/news/articles/thaemine-the-first-details]Thaemine The First Details Article[/url].

[h3]First Clear Leaderboard[/h3]
Want to keep an eye on the competition? Checkout the [url=https://www.playlostark.com/community/leaderboards/thaemine]Thaemine The First Leaderboard[/url], where the first teams to successfully clear in each region will live in Arkesian history.


[h3]Thaemine The First Highlight Submission[/h3]
We want to highlight the most memorable community moments from your journey to first clear. Share your highlights for a chance to appear in our community spotlight video.

When you have a clip or highlight you’d like to share with us, please [url=https://amazongames.canto.com/u/u-a69a0c43183b49518769f2c4af3b9ded_f5f6089340964c3f9efe47f8daac1183?viewIndex=0]Submit Here[/url].

Upon clicking the link you’ll see an option to upload a file. When you choose the clip you want to upload, you will be prompted to enter a description and an author. The description can be a summary of the clip, or something you’d like us to watch out for. The author is your in-game name so that you can get credit in the video. 

Our team will review your clips and put the best of the best in a highlight video commemorating the Lost Ark community’s epic quest to clear Thaemine The First. Not everyone who submits a clip will be included, but we welcome everyone to participate.

As for which clips to submit, they can be whatever you want to share with the community. Obviously if you’re one of the players who clears Thaemine The First, we’d love to see it! But it doesn’t all have to be triumphs. Maybe you pull off some great plays, score some epic kills, or just experience hilarious fails. We want to see it all!

Once you’re ready to take on Thaemine The First, please share your clips with our team. Looking for more details? View the [url=https://www.amazon.com/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201482650]Amazon Games Privacy Policy[/url].

We’ll see you in Arkesia, and wish you luck as face the Darkness Legion Commander, Thaemine.

notes.title: Lost Ark x Discord Quests
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/7yB0ldaz5LKmKUfRa4VjLM/16e24248a55380e6ded14a6e5cc7190a/LA_Thaemine_Discord_Mokoko_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
Heroes of Arkesia,

We're excited to partner with Discord on a Quest to bring even more Mokokos to one of your favorite apps. Simply stream Lost Ark in Discord for 15 minutes to earn a Mokoko Discord Avatar Decoration. Whether you run Raids, Dailies, or something else entirely, the Quest for an affectionate Mokoko hug is available now through April 23 for all Discord users. You don’t have to join the official Lost Ark channel for this quest, although we’d love for you to [url=https://discord.com/invite/lostark]join our community[/url]!

[h2]THE QUEST FOR MOKOKO[/h2]
This Discord Quest can be completed entirely through the Discord UI. Here’s how to walk away with your next Avatar Decoration:
[list]
[*] Discord's premium services are restricted in some regions. If you are unable to access the Gift Inventory, you are not eligible for this Quest or reward.
[*] All quests can be found at the top of the Gift Inventory section of Discord on both Desktop and the App. There should be a ‘New’ badge indicating a new Quest is available. Please note, this Quest can be accepted on Desktop but must be completed in App.
[*] The Lost Ark Quest can also appear in the Quest bar above your Discord voice chat options.
[*] Once accepted, the Quest bar will show your progress through a percentage bar.
[*] Upon completion, you can visit the Quest in the Gift Inventory to claim your reward.
[/list]
Share your stream with friends or save a favorite moment for the future. Additional information on Discord Quests can be found [url=https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/22817772345495-Lost-Ark-Quest]here[/url]. In the meantime, we’ll see you in Arkesia.

notes.title: Community Emote Design Competition
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/5xSS2qts4sO542vzmOqJcz/f6326762b5b9266d16283bb1a33570b5/LA_Oct_Press_Screenshots_Pleccia_024_1080.jpeg[/img]

Heroes of Arkesia,

Nearly a year ago the first community emote design competition accompanied Maykoko fest, and we’re excited to announce that a new competition will be returning, starting today! This year, the theme will be ‘Lost Ark Characters’ to allow players a wide variety of creative freedom. Emotes should be based around fan-favorite Lost Ark NPCs (including Sidereals, Legion Commanders, rapport characters, Mokokos, or other notable characters from Arkesia). If you're looking for inspiration, you can think about these characters emotions when seeing or facing Thaemine. 

In Korea, player-centric emotes were added to the game when the first group proved victorious over Thaemine. While we have plenty planned to celebrate the first groups to clear in the West (learn more in the Thaemine The First Details Article), we wanted to open up the emote section after the wildly successful competition last year that resulted in many of the most popular emotes being added to the game.

[h3]Competition Details[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/1o3068D5bD7JdntM8bHTQz/7056690db9b0702003dce5c624396ce6/Kadan_KA_01_1920x1080.jpg[/img]

Submission collection for the emote contest will run from April 8 to April 29. After the submission deadline ends on April 29, our teams at Amazon Games and Smilegate RPG will spend a few days selecting 10 finalists. Once the finalists are selected, the 10 emotes will be added to Discord, and the Lost Ark community can vote on their favorites by using reactions in Discord from May 3 - 10. At the end of the week, the top 5 will be selected as winners and added into the game for all players to use! Adding the final emotes to the game will take several months, and a final date will be announced after the competition.

The prizes? The five winners will have their emotes uploaded into Lost Ark for the community to use! Additionally, all ten finalists will receive the ‘Masterpiece Creator’ Title in game, and the 10 finalist emotes will be available for players to use in the [url=https://discord.gg/playlostark]Official Lost Ark Discord[/url].

You can enter your submissions to the emote contest through the [url=https://discord.gg/playlostark]Official Lost Ark Discord[/url] by creating a post in the 2024 Emote Contest section of Discord (#2024-emote-contest-entries) with the image of your artwork attached. The submission requirements include: 
[list][*] Submissions must be centered around an NPC in Lost Ark (including Sidereals, Legion Commanders, rapport characters, Mokokos, or other notable characters from Arkesia). Player characters do not count.
[*] A JPG or PNG under 25mb
[*] Ideal emote size is 500x500 at 300 DPI.
[*] Submission emotes need to be static images with transparent backgrounds unless there are intentional design decisions requiring a background color.
[*] Submissions must include character name and server name of the player submitting.[/list]
When preparing the winning emotes to be put in-game, some details may be removed or adjusted to better fit the game. Find the full contest rules here.

If you’re unable to find the 2024 Emote Contest section of Discord, you can add the relevant channels to your list of viewable channels on the left side of your screen by navigating to “Channels & Roles” in the top left of the Discord UI, then navigating to “Browse Channels” and selecting the channels you would like to see.

We’re excited to see what the community submits! Don’t forget to enter your emote submissions before the April 29 deadline, and check back on May 3 to vote on your favorite finalists.

notes.title: The Saga of Thaemine
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=1SRW1ICUid0;full][/previewyoutube]

Heroes of Arkesia,

The Darkness Legion Commander’s arrival is imminent. Thaemine is the most powerful of the Legion Commanders who once conquered half of Petrania alone, long ago. After facing Kazeros, he accepted the role of the Legion Commander of Darkness. Now, the loyal knights imbued with Thaemine's dark blessings rush to Arkesia, leading demons from other Legions. The saga of Thaemine will unfold throughout the month of April, with three key dates for adventurers to keep an eye on.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/3zlrqewA9s73vxgy3nvAVw/f9d3789ceec2955ffb5ea3e2bd40109a/LA_Thaemine_Prelude_Screenshots_G_Final_1080_CT-000005777.jpeg[/img]

[h2]Thaemine’s Arrival[/h2]
The Thaemine Prologue Dark Days story questline arrives tomorrow, on April 3. In this new storyline, players will help Thirain investigate new, mysterious events unfolding in Luterra. Find the release notes for the prologue in the next section.

Two weeks later, the Darkness Legion Commander will arrive in Arkesia. The Thaemine Legion Raid Normal and Hard difficulties will release on April 17, in the major April monthly update. Triumphing over Thaemine in his dark fortress will grant players the ability to claim new power in the form of a new progression system— Transcendence. As we approach Thaemine’s arrival in the major April update, more details on the new systems and other content updates can be found in the release notes.

During the weekend following the April update, the original Thaemine The First difficultly will open for a special race to clear on April 20. Later this week, we’ll release an article with details for players eager to compete.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/uafeJu689mRMSoYp9Rv0J/ccf52aa42147e35146ceb45e200fa3cd/LA_Thaemine_Prelude_Screenshots_F_Final_1080_CT-000005777.jpeg[/img]

[h2]Thaemine Prologue Release Notes[/h2]
The Dark Days questline will arrive after the weekly maintenance. Downtime will begin on April 3 at 12AM PT (7 AM UTC) and is expected to last 6 hours.

Thirain, the King of Luterra, swore on his legendary sword Vanquisher that he would always protect the people of Luterra and Arkesia, as he and his knights have ever since the emergence of Chaos Gates. However, suspicious events are occurring in Luterra. Experience a new line of story quests that lead into the Thaemine Legion Raid. The prologue quests will require Item Level 1520.

New relevant quests added, along with a new Achievement and Title. The starting quest for the Thaemine Prologue is ‘Red Mist After Dusk’. This quest can be accepted in the following cities:
[list][*] Voldis: Kalinar (NPC Hogun)
[*] North Vern: Vern Castle (NPC Hogun)
[*] Elgacia: Ereonnor (Transparent Mirror)[/list]
Prerequisite Quests:
[list][*] Found Key, Pulsating Volcano – Episode ‘Light of Destiny’ Quest
[*] Adento's Legacy - Voldis World Quest[/list]
Restrictions:
[list][*] While progressing the Thaemine Prologue quest line, partial normal or rapport quests in Luterra Castle cannot be progressed at the same time.
[*] After completing the Thaemine Prologue quest line, cannot participate in 'Festivals and Parties' - Luterra Castle co-op quest for a while.
[*] The Thaemine Prologue can be completed once per Roster.[/list]
Make sure to stay tuned into our website and social channels for news and updates as Thaemine’s arrival grows closer. In the meantime, we’ll see you in Arkesia.
